synthesis.overnight_summary: Gold extended its post-CPI rebound: hotter-than-expected US PPI (6.3% y/y) was overshadowed by a ~10bp drop in US yields (10Y ~5.08%, TIPS 2.76%) and a weaker dollar, lifting spot from ~$4,148 at the MCX close to ~$4,170 by 09:00 IST and ~$4,180 later. Fed Chair Warsh gave no October signal in Bangkok, October hike odds fell back to ~26-30% (December still ~92%) and the dollar slid to a near two-week low. The rupee opened 30 paise stronger at 94.75 on RBI curbs, offsetting most of the COMEX gain, so the model fair open was only ~Rs 147,816 (+Rs 327). MCX instead opened at 148,431, ~Rs 615 rich (dislocated), and held 148,400-148,750 through the day as spot firmed. The open premium was partly absorbed by spot gains, but the rupee and the $4,200 cap leave MCX near the top of its fair band.
